summary: Duplicating a workflow template skips schedules, notifications and permissions and makes the copier admin; unlike other resources, a workflow whose nodes use unauthorized templates, inventories or credentials can still be copied, with those node fields left empty.
questions: How do I duplicate a workflow job template?
Why are some node fields empty in my copied workflow?
Why can't I duplicate a project in AAP?
Are schedules copied when duplicating a workflow?
